purpose: Learn a mask-conditioned structure predictor on the actual nested action rig, then support a separately trained posterior-moment/NPPC comparison. No independent novelty from FiLM or a response loss.
data_split: original train8000: first4000 mean-predictor training, last4000 reserved for subsequent residual/covariance training; original1000validation and1000internalassessment unchanged
feature: Full180-receiver Tikhonov map T with lambda=1e-5||A_full||^2, computed once; density-compensated masked adjoint feature f0=(30/n_selected_blocks)*y_mask@T. This is NOT an exact subset Tikhonov inverse.
mask: always include initial[0,6,12,18,24]; sample number of extra blocks uniformly0..10, then choose without replacement from25 remaining blocks; mask is explicitly supplied to network
training_noise: fresh independent circular complex Gaussian sigma1e-4 on each train exposure, instead of memorizing one noise draw
evaluation_noise: the same already frozen full-rig measurements for every model and policy
network: four-level width32 residual U-Net, identity-initialized FiLM at encoder blocks conditioned on30mask bits plus fraction; output residual added to observation-only feature

losses.joint: same image loss plus normalized all15 physical queryMSE

training.selection: every400steps on first256validation objects at extra budgets0,2,5,10; imageMSE selects image, combined loss selects joint

evaluation: fixed per-object random nested order seed20261116+object_id; full1000internal objects at budgets0,2,5,10 after selection; these are development results, not official test
posterior_followup: Freeze image mean predictor before learning residual covariance on reserved4000 objects. NPPC plus physical readout is an explicit required control; covariance calibration and acquisition benefit are not assumed.
